cards.description: Leadership Philosophy:  Inspire and motivate staff by setting a shared vision that sets high standards for all, fostering a positive school culture that is both collaborative and inclusive, promote staff growth and professional development, and focus on increasing student achievement by enhancing teaching practices.

cards.description: Leadership Philosophy: Effective leadership is built on high expectations, collaboration, and continuous growth through creating a supportive and inspiring school culture where students and staff feel valued, empowered, and motivated to achieve their full potential.

cards.description:
Leadership Philosophy: Fostering a caring and inclusive environment supported by strong pedagogy, continuous professional development, and a commitment to literacy development within a global education framework. 

Parent collaboration is an integral part of every learner’s success and works to build meaningful partnerships that support the academic, social, and emotional growth of all students.

cards.title: Johnette Hopkins Williams

cards.description:
Leadership Philosophy: Foster student-centered learning by creating inclusive and engaging environments that support every learner’s growth, while empowering teachers to design creative and innovative lessons driven by data to ensure purposeful and responsive instruction, thereby equipping high school students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset needed to succeed beyond the classroom and thrive in the real world, while strengthening connections
with alumni to inspire, mentor, and
give back.
cards.subtitle: Head of High School; Teaching, Learning and Assessment Coordinator
cards.title: Meriam Mneimneh

cards.description: Leadership Philosophy: Foster a respectful, inclusive, and disciplined school environment where every student is empowered to reach their full potential, through consistency, fairness, resilience, and effective communication, while building strong and positive relationships with students, staff, and parents. This approach emphasizes character development, accountability, and high expectations to support both academic success and personal growth, while contributing to the UAE National Agenda

Leadership Philosophy: Emphasize the social and emotional development of students while cultivating critical thinking and providing enriching opportunities that challenge learners to grow, guided by the belief that “how you treat others is the truest measurement of your character.”
